name: Cowardice, Lesser
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [despair, mind-affecting]; Level antipaladin 1, bard 1, bloodrager 2, inquisitor 2, lathspell 1, medium 1, mesmerist 1, psychic 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, spiritualist 2, summoner/unchained summoner 2, witch 2

DESCRIPTION

This spell acts as cowardice, except on a failed save the target becomes doubting.
